title: row20
live_proof: inspection with line numbers in the 3.22.0 tree: blobReadWrite() calls sqlite3BtreeIntegerKey() at vdbeblob.c:420 with no cursor-valid check, and the preupdate hook runs with that key at :421. Fixed upstream in 3.51.0 by reseeking first and skipping the hook if it cannot restore
object: the btree page the blob cursor was parked on
lifetime_ender: another writer modifies or deletes the row, so the cursor is saved and the page released, but pCur->pPage is left set
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator. Needs -DSQLITE_ENABLE_PREUPDATE_HOOK, without which the second half of the sequence does not exist
